title: When Opposites Become Causes: A Cross-Domain Science of Oppositional Causal Inversion
domain: metascience / causal inference / psychology / economics / organization science / international relations / information science / complex systems
summary: A falsification-first cross-domain framework for testing when an increase in a construct causally produces a prespecified functional opposite after actor, level, time, construct, environment, feedback, or capacity indices change. A 30-record Coder A feasibility pass is complete; independent coding and reproducible retrieval remain hard gates. Orwell's triad is a stress test, not a conclusion.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided design with live prior-art audit and falsification-first framing
